#   build/emulator-viewer/soa-viewer the unmodified offline 3.8.0 client (emulator-viewer/README.md)
Tools and notes for the **offline** build of *STAR OCEAN: anamnesis* (JP, v3.8.0, `com.square_enix.android_googleplay.StarOceanj`), released after the Japanese service closed in June 2021.

- `docs/libsoa-3.7.0-vs-3.8.0.md`: what changed in `libSOA.so` between the last online build (3.7.0) and the offline 3.8.0 build, by subsystem, with the master-DB and asset differences and how the port restores 3.7.0 beh
- `apk/`: the XAPK (Git LFS).
| `port/` | the desktop port of the offline 3.8.0 game (`port/README.md`) | `build/port/soa` |
| `emulator-viewer/` | the unmodified offline 3.8.0 client (`emulator-viewer/README.md`) | `build/emulator-viewer/soa-viewer` |

| `scripts/run-port.sh` | the desktop port with the online game restored: the 3.8.0 client plus native code, against the local server built into it (`--restore`). `--offline` runs the shipped 3.8.0 offline game instead.

| `scripts/run-viewer-380.sh` | the offline 3.8.0 client, unmodified, in the viewer (`emulator-viewer/`, `soa-viewer`): the game as shipped after the service ended. No server: its one request goes unanswered, as on a pho
| `work/extracted/xapk/` (the 3.8.0 XAPK, unpacked by `tools/extract.sh`) | the port; the 3.8.0 viewer |

`roster` and `unlock-all` read the decrypted master database committed at `data/basmaster-3.8.0.sqlite3` (Git LFS, named for the game version it came from). If it is missing, they decrypt it again from the XAPK.
